name: veterinary_clinic_system_004_fvrcp_kitten_series_check
instruction: Feline patients whose FVRCP booster will come due within the next 30 days (from the episode date in ops_meta) need a head's-up before the window opens. For every feline patient with an FVRCP vaccination whose due_date falls in (episode_date, episode_date+30 days] and who has NO queued reminder yet, push one reminder_queue row with kind='vaccination_due', status='queued', queued_by='frontdesk@pawsclinic.com', due_date equal to the vaccination's due_date, and message '<PatientName> FVRCP booster due <YYYY-MM-DD> — book a nurse visit.' Finally, add a summary row with kind='compliance_summary', status='queued', and message='FVRCP due-in-30 count: <N>' where N is the number of reminder rows you created. Cats already covered by a queued vaccination_due reminder must be skipped but still counted in N as zero — i.e. N counts only rows actually created.

success_criteria.summary: Compute expected set: feline patients (join patients.species) with FVRCP due in (ep, ep+30d]; exclude those with existing queued vaccination_due rows (snapshot). Assert exactly one new row per expected patient with all fields correct (message date uses dp(due_date)). Assert exactly one new compliance_summary row with message count == number of created rows. Assert seeded 4 rows unchanged; total == 4 + N + 1.
